summary.en: A ring of cards turns a step at a time in front of a fixed camera; the card at the front is lit and named under the ring.
summary.zh: 一圈卡片在固定机位前一步一停地转动，转到正前方的那张被点亮，并在环下报出名字。

fits: A catalogue the viewer should feel is complete and browsable: templates, integrations, modes; a loop behind a title or a landing hero.
notFor: Comparing items (only one is legible at a time); fewer than six items (the ring reads empty); styles with a locked flat camera.

overlaps.note: a highlight frame jumps along a flat row and locks on the answer; ring-gallery turns the set itself

intent.en: Present a whole catalogue as one object the viewer could browse forever, naming one item per step, so the set feels complete and endless rather than a list that runs out.
intent.zh: 把整套目录做成一个可以一直翻下去的物件，每停一步报出一项，让观众觉得这一套完整、看不完，而不是一个会放完的列表。

content.en: 6–10 cards, each a stat-style tile with a label that doubles as the caption (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 8), an optional number (≤ 6 chars) and image; an eyebrow (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10) and a corner label (en ≤ 16, zh ≤ 8).
content.zh: 6–10 张卡，每张一个标签兼作环下字幕（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字），可选数字（≤ 6 字符）和图片；一行眉标（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）和角标（英文 ≤ 16，中文 ≤ 8）。

fits.zh: 要让观众觉得完整、可浏览的一套目录：模板、集成、模式；也可当标题背后的循环层或落地页主视觉。

notFor.zh: 比较各项（同一时刻只看得清一张）；少于六项（环会显得空）；机位锁死不动的平面风格。

pairs.note: a title line over the turning ring

en: A steady ring has no beginning or end; as the main shot it reads flat, so lay a title or a camera move over it.
Front and back faces must carry the same content; the ring never flips a card to reveal.
The dimming by depth and the reflection are tuned for a dark ground; on white blend the dimming toward the ground and drop the reflection to about 5 %.
zh: 稳态环转没有开头结尾，单独当主镜偏平；上面叠标题或相机运动。
卡的正反面必须是同一份内容；环转时不能靠翻面揭示。
纵深压暗和倒影按暗底调的；换白底要把压暗改成向底色混合、倒影降到 5% 左右。

upstream.name: 环形画廊
upstream.summary: 8 张卡排成圆环整环自转一圈（匀速底 + 每 45° 一次停靠的分步），每卡只绕 Y 公转、自身 billboard 朝外，正反两层同向贴图配 backface-visibility:hidden 保证任何时刻都正立不倒置，正前方卡被点亮、环下字幕随之换字，相机全程钉在浅俯角
upstream.use: 作品集/模板库/集成清单的循环展示；需要无缝 loop 的背景拍或落地页 hero
upstream.energy: 中（可无限循环的稳态运动，每 45° 一次停靠给出节拍）
